observations.body: Law and conscience meet a coming judgment. For as many as have sinned without the law will also perish without the law. As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law. in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.

payload.posture: Read Romans 2:12–16 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states law and conscience meet a coming judgment. For as many as have sinned without the law will also perish without the law. As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law. in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
